_comment: Clip A3 (recording_shot_list.md): as A2, but the air dash is at an angle to the travel direction. As written it is the
45 deg case (W+D held from the dash tick on). Per trial, edit the entry that starts on the dash tick:
75 deg: "move": [1, 1] plus "yaw_deg": <the mouse flick, ~30> (use ang_yaw from the extract).
h_along / h_across split the horizontal velocity along/across the pre-dash travel direction, measured in
align.ref_window (after the dash-jump takeoff, before the air dash).
Put the A2 results (dash_jump_set_speed, dash_jump_vertical_speed) in 'fixed' before fitting, so the pre-dash state is right.
Model comparison (the point of this clip): fixed air_dash_cap_mode 1 (Hyp A, keep the perpendicular part) vs 2 (set).
If both fit poorly, the rotate-toward-dash model (V3 4:39, V10 1:47) is needed: a code change under G01, not a new cap.
fit_window (times from sim tick 0) ends at landing (~1.25 s at 45 deg; extend it for trials that land later): ground friction is not part of this fit.
Alignment: first rising crossing of speed_h through value_u (the ground dash start), as in A2.
Bounds are search limits, not game limits: a result on a bound is flagged in the report.
